source_text: Ἀγαπῶμεν τοὺς ἐχθροὺς οὐ καθὸ μοιχοί εἰσιν ἢ φονεῖς, ἀλλὰ καθὸ ἄνθρωποι· τὸ γὰρ ἁμαρτάνειν ἐνεργείας ἐστίν, οὐκ οὐσίας· διὸ οὐδὲ ἔργον θεοῦ ἡ ἁμαρτία.
pass_a_gloss: Let-us-love the enemies not insofar adulterers they are or murderers, but insofar humans; for the to-sin of activity is, not of essence; wherefore neither work of God the sin.
pass_b_english: Let us love enemies not insofar as they are adulterers or murderers, but insofar as they are human. Sinning belongs to activity, not to essence; that is why sin is not God’s work (Matthew 5:44).

choices.why: Love the human; hate the act.
